title.narrative: Emergency Earthquake Response to affected communities in Nangarhar

description.narrative: This project is designed to respond quickly to the urgent needs of families affected by the earthquake in Nangarhar Province. It will provide direct-cash worth GBP 110 to each household. The amount follows the Cash and Voucher Working Group (CVWG) standards and is enough to help families cover their most immediate food and non-food needs. By receiving cash instead of goods, households will have the freedom to decide what is most important for them in this critical time. The support will focus on the most at-risk families such as pregnant and lactating women, elderly-headed households, female-headed households, child-headed households, and those living with disabilities or long-term illnesses. These groups often struggle the most after disasters, facing higher risks of hunger, poor living conditions, and disease. In total, 441 vulnerable households will benefit from this project.
